spec.behavior: Allocate independent 4096x4096 Float64 arrays filled with 1 and 2, allocate their elementwise sum, validate the original shape, element count, and bottom-right corner, consume every summed element in a complete checksum, and print the validation record.
spec.workload: Every implementation owns two independent 4096x4096 Float64 inputs and one separately allocated 4096x4096 Float64 output. The checksum traverses the complete output; no implementation reuses a preallocated input or boxes the Jet tensor.
